svg.text: THE VGA PALETTE: WHERE IT COMES FROM AND WHEN IT CHANGES
Tandy and EGA call gSetPalette with a built-in 16-entry table (ds:3057); CGA has no palette (the CGA driver's SetPalette is a stub).
The five .PAL files differ little from EOBPAL.COL: 6 entries (BRICK) to 41 (DROW) differ in their low six bits. A .PAL byte may also carry 11b in its top
THE 256 ENTRIES OF EACH WALL SET'S PALETTE
differ: 6 used by the block tables: 0C E0 E1 .. F6
differ: 40 used by the block tables: F0 F1 F2 .. FE
differ: 41 used by the block tables: E2 E3 E4 .. EE
differ: 34 used by the block tables: F0 F1 F2 .. FE
differ: 33 used by the block tables: F0 F1 F2 .. FE
index named by the set's colour tables A and B
